replaces: the shares of each system in the diet
provisioning_food_systems.rule: Bind the study's per-system P applied, recovered and lost per person; the ledger and routes then follow.

evidence: A screen on committed and bound products: the ecology product's land loss split into its dissolved and particulate parts, passed through the rain-fed lakes by the waters product's rerun routing and Earth lake-retention relations, into linear sea boxes built on the resources box model; Earth figures from the literature for food systems, recovery, dredging, seaweed, fishing and the ocean. No sea chemistry, sediment diagenesis, lake ecology, food-web or carrier population is simulated, and no food system, route or population is chosen.
reading_rule: Phosphorus in kg of elemental P and flows per Julian year unless a key names Tg (1e9 kg), kt (1e6 kg) or g/m2. Pairs are [low, high] with every range taken at the end that bounds the quantity named; ledger corners pair each land-loss end with each population end. Concentrations are mg P per m3 of water (= ug/L) with uM beside them. Per-billion values are per 1e9 people on the Moon. 'screen' marks numbers this code computes, 'derived' arithmetic on cited values. Shares of the land's loss use the ecology product's 1.47-4.16 Tg a year. The waters product's lakes are connected bodies of the drainage product's fill-and-spill lakes; its outlets include every cell below the common water level, so 'all common-level water' bounds the named seas' input from above and their direct inflow from below. Bioavailable inputs: 'base' is dissolved P; 'with_particle_release' adds Earth's 10-30% reactive share of all river P, which salinity or anoxic beds release from particles.

hydroponic_p_efficiency.basis: closed recirculation with bleed and residue P returned; reusing the fifth of the solution that drained applied 3-18% less P than an open system

food_waste_p_return.basis: composted or digested food losses back on the fields

sediment_dry_bulk_t_m3.basis: fine lake muds to sandy deltas, in place

sorption_capture.basis: share of the dissolved P a contactor takes from the water it treats

sorption_concentrate_mol_l.basis: the phosphate concentrate the minimum work runs to

extraction_ceiling_share.basis: largest share of a water body's bioavailable input taken by fish, seaweed or sorption; the rest stays with its food webs and carriers

replaces: the shares of each system in the diet
pending_binding.rule: Bind the study's per-system P applied, recovered and lost per person; the ledger and routes then follow.

ledger.basis: Steady state: people's losses join the land's in the waters and are dredged back from the lake deposits; carriers return the wild land's dissolved loss, 30% of the land kept wild at the low land loss and half at the high; every other P is buried. The field-crop case sends all P the crops do not recover to the waters, an upper bound while soils build stores.
